title: Public Guest Chat observer ignores rendered pre-package assistant replies
surface: Public Store v0.2.205 native Guest Chat acceptance harness
organization_context: Fresh signed-out guest; no bearer, profile or selected organization.
preconditions: Exact public Store v0.2.205 CRX; current acceptance harness.

reproduction: Run guarded public Guest Chat acceptance 39127287861.
Send the opening question, allow get_page_text delegation and its continuation to complete.
Observe terminal_empty_answer with replyCount=0 even though the failure screenshot visibly contains an assistant response.
expected: Read the exact public assistant Markdown bodies and Stop control; require a new grounded answer plus correlated semantic terminal success before any pass.
actual: Both streams ended successfully with 4 then 21 text chunks and one continuation; screenshot shows answer prose while the package-only article selector records zero assistant articles and empty latestAssistantReply.
reproducibility: Resource-admitted native run plus deterministic captured public MessageRow/Markdown markup test; original observer returns [] instead of both completed answer bodies.
severity: S2: acceptance observer falsely labels visible public Guest Chat response empty; product failure unproven.

cause: readPackageChatControls recognizes package Assistant answer articles and data-message-content only. Public .205 uses div.group.space-y-2 with direct Markdown children and a trailing Copy reply control; its Stop uses title=Stop and a Square icon.
sibling_census: The shared observer supplies both Guest reply extraction and collector replyCount. Public Stop observation was also missing. New package article, tool-card exclusion and accessible Stop behavior remain covered. Member screenshot geometry explicitly targets the new package surface and is not used by public Guest acceptance.
reviewer: Fresh independent peer: source/test adequacy PASS after enabled-Stop correction; native evidence PARTIAL, retest pending.

Fresh independent review and resource-valid exact-public-CRX native opening, follow-up and post-reload retest precede product credit.
